name: Holly Wright
reason: Health rule: her own site, oceanofpeace.org (Chattanooga, Tennessee; robots.txt allows us), is sold on conditions: the home page offers frequencies for pain, illness and anxiety and lists pain relief, faster recovery from injury and surgery and immunity as benefits, and its blog leads with skeletal alignment and '528 Hz DNA repair'; her profile also names medical qigong.
